source: Manba: Adobe Digital Insights bayram savdosi prognozi, 2026-09-28

scenes.text: Amerikada ikkita katta onlayn savdo kuni bor. Black Friday va Cyber Monday.
scenes.head: JUMA vs DUSHANBA

scenes.text: Adobe prognozi: Cyber Mondayda o'n besh butun o'ndan bir milliard dollar.
scenes.head: CYBER MONDAY

scenes.text: Black Fridayda esa o'n ikki butun o'ndan to'qqiz milliard.
scenes.head: BLACK FRIDAY

scenes.text: Shoshmen... lekin Black Friday tezroq o'syapti.
scenes.head: KIM TEZ O'SYAPTI?

scenes.text: To'qqiz butun o'ndan ikki foiz, olti butun o'ndan ikkiga qarshi.
scenes.head: +9.2% vs +6.2%

scenes.text: Black Fridayning o'zida sakkiz yuz yetti million dollar hozir ol, keyin to'la bilan ketadi.
scenes.head: HOZIR OL, KEYIN TO'LA

scenes.text: Sila qaysi jamoa: juma yoki dushanba?
scenes.head: JUMA YOKI DUSHANBA?

scenes.text: Sila bilan chala amerikali finansist bo'ldi.
scenes.head: CHALA AMERIKALI FINANSIST
